entries: {DISASTER:strikes} came to {place}, and {first} was the first to see {landmark}
{MESSAGE:physical} arrived from {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, asking {first} to come to {landmark}
{SOMEONE:!plural} came to {place} {MANNER} and would not say why
the {rival} blamed {SOMEONE:human,!plural} for {DISASTER}, and {first} knew it was not so
{first} heard knocking at {landmark} {MANNER}, and {SOMEONE:!plural} was there
{SOMEONE:human,!plural} vanished {MANNER}, and {first} was the last to see it
{DISASTER:manmade} came to light {MANNER}, and the {rival} wanted it forgotten
{first} was asked to {DO_THING} {THING} {DEADLINE}, and wondered why
